contracts.guarantee: Retired history is excluded from new planning; original positions are not compacted
Native proposals commit only at the explicit boundary; late protection is rechecked
Host quota includes reservations and retained readers until final ownership release
Physical capacity pressure includes unsealed native pages
Partial-tail restore invalidates descriptors; Query snapshot stays stable during a round
Transfer failure and stale plans do not publish an incomplete working set
Idle checkpoint aliases can be removed while an admitted state reference survives
Replica eviction preserves valid data and charges transition/leased allocations
Content/history versions participate in compatibility checks
Native GC refuses max_concurrency != 1; retired pages are filtered in Query/pressure/checkpoint paths
Native prefill wait is bounded at two seconds and may release detached ownership on the foreground
Strict whole-request NInfer GC reservation is not implemented
General Engine durable recovery and system-wide permanent forgetting remain incomplete; archive-only authority/fences are qualified independently
Boundary handoff does not acquire worker mutexes; batch ownership and acknowledgement are exactly once
Boundary commits evaluate fixed metadata, atomic epochs and native protection without invoking arbitrary policy code or acquiring range mutexes
Retry preserves the originally authorized epoch; Query replacement and range edits revoke old conditions, monotone prefix growth does not starve them

Redundancy retirement binds exact Live witness identity/version atomically to victim retirement; same-batch witness removal, freed/reused witnesses and malformed provenance are rejected without permanent pins
Scored intents bind feature schema, Query epoch, frozen score-bank epoch and round; raw attention updates do not revoke a frozen bank; ACK records the committed witness

Explicit shared auxiliary budget caps requested allocator bytes of PageFeatures, ThinkingRanges and redundancy containers including nested edges and scoring temporaries; transient reallocation and old owners remain charged, failures roll back and policy exhaustion preserves old reclamation

Explicit shared auxiliary account covers GC/bridge owned objects and queues, LRU scratch, repository slot directory/control block, observations and reservation handles; old leases retain real charges; constructor faults/denials roll back; native registration/boundary/ACK/reuse and repeated Retry do not allocate
Policy/worker/stopped health is visible and sticky; unhealthy owners reject new capacity and boundary batches, old retirements can drain; thread startup failure does not silently restart
GC-specific Mean-Q staging is charged to auxiliary budget and matches existing FP32 semantics and independent FP64 oracle in mean/max aggregation

A consumed execution batch with explicit KVMem quota failure settles only its request membership, reports typed unavailability and preserves the Engine and pending FIFO; stale consumed sequences are not aborted again

An owner-serialized RAM source directory preserves accepted token IDs independently of derived KV retirement, separately tracks computed frontier, bounds directory and real buffer capacities including transient growth, rejects pressure without forgetting, and fences stale revisions/store identities and explicitly forgotten descendant records; capture/append/branch allocation failure publishes nothing partial

Native recording keeps admitted input independent of computed KV, records only accepted output after whole commits, exposes real S bounds and preserves request-local quota/cancel cleanup and pending FIFO; no recovery execution claim

Explicit canonical source rebuild planning requires a different owner-issued domain identity, compatible current source configuration, complete prefix/output capacity and current source/domain revisions. Source staging has a separate real HostKvStorage charge and strong allocation-failure guarantee; local forget or changed source/domain/configuration rejects reads. Planning/staging neither reserve model state nor publish a recovered native computation.

Explicit canonical source rebuild uses a fresh native domain and ordinary Engine reservation/execution, revalidates source receipts, refuses incomplete retention, returns R on cancellation and completion, and preserves old retirement; required qualification includes actual reclaimed pages inside the rebuilt prefix, source-only rebuild after old-window eviction, independent fresh-ID oracle, real MTP rounds, reserve/capacity rejection and first-token stop. Results are recorded separately, not implied by this manifest. Each terminal request returns its own accepted-source receipt (including partial cancellation), and explicit rebuild branches expose exact parent/prefix metadata independently of later requests.

Quiescent Engine-local source-family forget revokes retained native KV/checkpoint/coverage aliases before source deletion; prepared rebuilds fail admission without early R refund, stale/busy preflight is nonmutating, independent sources survive; no persisted/global external erasure claim.

Existing checkpoint pool C charges pinned images including idle/execution aliases and scoped metadata/rollback reservations until actual owner exit; construction failures refund, quota refusal cleans the request locally, pressure evicts optional old domains and source-only rebuild remains bounded. Not an RSS bound or arbitrary restore qualification.

Bounded immutable source DATA copies use shared real R; explicit little-endian framing and configuration/length/event/checksum checks reject invalid reads; allocation and transport failure preserve source/real-owner charges. Origin annotations are never durable publication/import capabilities.

Current catalog/seal authority, monotonically consumed namespaced identities, owner-issued publication receipts and append/version/family fences; real shared M tables, R payloads, bounded jobs/object slots and D reservations; delayed cleanup distinguishes reservation refunds from actual unlinked file bytes. No Engine import/global erasure claim.

Atomic source DATA import reserves both real S buffers, copies bounded chunks, preserves events, creates a fresh RAM root with computed0; quota/allocation failure publishes nothing. No archive or old-KV authority from decoded provenance.

Only a current owner-issued read receipt can import/bind a durable key; duplicate live binding refuses. Durable blob order prevents stale saves across reset/colliding process-local SourceRef counters. Four independent executables save/import-append/reimport-forget/reopen-deny.

Current Frontend/Program namespace verification, separate I/O receipt and owner publication, new RAM roots and domains after restart, durable-family plus online alias forget, ambiguous-commit closure; seventeen independent-process native model cases passed.

RebuildAsNew remains full-prefix fit. ReplayAsNew requires explicit adapter capability, aligned unit<=append reserve, selected+rounded append<=window, prefix+logical completion<=context, exact R charge and source/forget fences.

Full32K source from archive into a fresh sparse domain through normal reservations/units, independent fresh raw-input output comparison, actual multi-window cancellation, completion/R refusal, revoked preparation and reopen denial; fourteen native model-environment process cases passed.
